scores.notes: Both show a grassy ridged croquet lawn bounded by a garden wall with large leafy trees, shrubs and hoops played by card soldiers; the right is seen from under a tree with a greyer wall and hedge, a compatible corner of the same walled ground.

The house conflicts: left is a thatched, rose-covered half-timbered cottage, right is a grey clapboard house with a columned veranda; the table is a short one on the left and a very long laid table on the right.

Both show a rough grassy croquet lawn inside a walled garden with clipped hedges, cypresses and big leafy trees, card soldiers bent as hoops and hedgehogs about; the right is seen from under a tree with more furrowed turf, a compatible viewpoint.
Both show a lush uneven green lawn enclosed by the same red-brick garden wall with mature leafy trees behind it under a cloudy sky, with playing-card hoops and flamingos in play.

The pale clapboard house with a porch and the big tree agree, but the tea table itself conflicts: left is a short bare plank table with crockery heaped on the grass beneath, right is a long table covered by a stained white cloth.

Left is an open lawn bounded by a red brick wall with fruit trees and giant card arches; right is bounded by a grey stone wall with tall clipped hedges and conical topiary and uses small wire hoops, so the enclosure conflicts.

Both show a patchy green lawn with hedgehogs and croquet hoops backed by a low pinkish brick wall and tall garden trees; the right's clipped hedge block and cypresses fit a different view of the same walled garden.

The tree, grass and white-clothed table agree, but the house conflicts: left is a low plain tan clapboard cottage with a simple lean-to porch, right is a tall pale grey-violet Victorian house with a steep central gable, arched upper window and ornate trim.

Left is enclosed by a grey stone wall with tall clipped hedges and conical topiary; right is an open lawn bounded by a red brick wall with a flower border and spreading trees, so the garden's enclosure conflicts.

Both show a long plank table on grass under a spreading oak with a pale clapboard house with a front porch close behind; the cloth covers the planks on the right and not on the left, but tree, house type and garden agree.

Both have a clothed table under a big tree, but the house conflicts: left is a cream stucco-and-stone cottage with dormers, a bay window and a small gabled porch, right is a weathered white clapboard house with shutters and a long columned veranda.

Both have a clothed table under an oak, but the house conflicts: left is a cream stucco cottage with a slate or shingle roof, dormers and a bay window, right is a thatched half-timbered cottage smothered in climbing roses.
